chars.A: ABDERRAHMANE: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.F: SALMA: a young woman wearing a lilac hijab and a long olive-green coat.
chars.S: ISSANE: a rough man wearing a black leather jacket over a white tank top, a thin gold chain, tattooed forearms.
chars.G: GIRL: a young woman with a messy bun wearing pink satin pajamas.
chars.X: MAN: a man wearing a white undershirt and red shorts.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On a Moroccan city street at dusk, ABDERRAHMANE points angrily at SALMA's phone while SALMA looks away nervously, hiding the phone screen against her chest. Open tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Early Saturday morning, ABDERRAHMANE drives a small car on a Moroccan highway with argan trees and hills, gripping the wheel, determined and worried face.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: ABDERRAHMANE, parked in a quiet Moroccan neighborhood, holds his phone to his ear impatiently; outside the car window ISSANE leans on a wall smoking and waves him over.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ISSANE leads ABDERRAHMANE toward a four-storey beige Moroccan apartment building with small balconies, ISSANE grinning slyly, ABDERRAHMANE suspicious.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: ABDERRAHMANE climbs a narrow tiled stairwell to the second floor of a Moroccan apartment building, hand on the railing, tense.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a dim stairwell landing, GIRL opens an apartment door holding a shisha hose, thick shisha smoke drifting out; ABDERRAHMANE stands outside the door, shocked, covering his nose.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the open front door: inside a smoky Moroccan apartment hallway MAN walks out of a room, GIRL laughs beside him, ABDERRAHMANE in the foreground at the door stares in disbelief.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: ABDERRAHMANE frozen just outside an apartment door on the landing, both hands over his mouth, eyes wide in horror, a bedroom door inside slightly open with warm light.
